info.title: OpenChat Installation API
info.description: REST contract for the dashboard, mobile app, and widget.

RealtimeTicket.description: Connect to `url` within 30 seconds. The ticket is good for one purpose only, and grants nothing over REST.

VisitorConversation.description: A deliberately reduced view, with no assignee, priority, or internal counters.

lastReadSeq.description: The caller's read position, for unread counts.

relay.description: Compared by the app with its build-time allowlist, and read by the relay to prove domain control.

refreshToken.description: Mobile only. Dashboard clients receive an HttpOnly cookie instead.

websiteKey.description: Public identifier embedded in page source. Not a credential.

post.summary: A ticket for a socket that receives everything in this workspace
A ticket for a socket that receives this conversation's public events

get.description: Frames are published as AgentServerFrame, AgentClientFrame, VisitorServerFrame, and VisitorClientFrame.

get.summary: Public configuration. Cached for 30 seconds. The Origin must be allowed for the website.

post.summary: Create or resume an anonymous visitor session. The Origin must be allowed for the website.
post.description: A refresh token that is unknown or belongs to another website starts a new visitor, with no history.

patch.summary: Provide a name, email, and follow-up consent
patch.description: An email is unverified, and never merges with an existing contact automatically.

post.summary: Start a conversation with a first message

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId. Returns the same conversation.

get.summary: Public messages only, oldest first. Here seq is the public sequence.

post.summary: Send a message. Rate limited per visitor and per website.

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId

post.summary: Move the visitor's delivered and read positions forward, in public sequence numbers

get.summary: An inbox view, most recent first

schema.description: A `syncCursor` from an earlier response. Returns everything changed since, in any status, oldest change first. Other filters are ignored.

parameters.description: A `syncCursor` from an earlier response. Returns everything changed since, in any status, oldest change first. Other filters are ignored.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

syncCursor.description: Pass as `updatedAfter` to catch up later.

patch.summary: Assign, transfer, resolve, reopen, archive, or reprioritise
patch.description: Compare-and-set on `expectedVersion`. A stale version answers 409 with the current version.

parameters.name: afterSeq

schema.description: Backward from this sequence number, for history.

parameters.description: Backward from this sequence number, for history.
parameters.name: beforeSeq

post.summary: Send a reply or an internal note

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId. Returns the original.

post.summary: Move the caller's delivered and read positions forward

get.summary: Describe this installation and its compatibility

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Rotate a refresh token. Reuse of an old token revokes the session.
Always returns 202, whether or not the account exists
Set a new password. Revokes all sessions for the user.

get.summary: The current user and their workspace memberships

post.summary: Anonymise the account and leave all workspaces. Needs the password. Refused for the last owner of a workspace.
post.description: A POST, because the password travels in the body and a DELETE body has no defined meaning. A wrong password answers 403, not 401, since the access token is valid and a client must not refresh and retry. Attempts share the login limit for the account.

post.summary: Create a workspace, subject to the installation signup policy

patch.summary: Change a role or status. A workspace must keep one active owner.

delete.summary: Remove a member and their push subscriptions

post.summary: Invite someone by email. Replaces any pending invitation for the address.
Accept an invitation. A new account needs a name and password; an existing account keeps its own.
Register a website and obtain its public key
